items.question: Who is described as all-knowing and refuge-loving?
premises: The verse names an all-knowing being.
Devotion makes that being easily won.
That being loves those who take refuge.
items.inference: The verse praises a divine figure accessible through devotion and refuge.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical gender and number are inferred from context.
items.plain_english: All-knowing, easily won by devotion, and loving to those who take refuge.

items.question: What kind of beings arise in terrible samsara?

uncertainties: The exact referent of the stained beings is not explicit.
items.plain_english: In worthless and terrible samsara, beings are stained by all sorrow.

items.question: Do beings born and dying in samsara have liberation?

items.question: By what means is one liberated, O lord?
premises: The speaker asks the lord of gods for the means of liberation.

items.plain_english: By what means, O lord of gods, is one liberated? Speak to me, O lord.

items.question: What liberates a man from samsara?
